title: OTHRYS OS project context to Trust Canal mission proposal
goal: Allow the tablet to turn the selected project context and an operator objective into a durable mission proposal admitted by Trust Canal, without execution authority.
laws: Mission proposal is a new bounded tablet intent, not direct mission execution.
Selected project context and objective are content-bound into the proposal digest.
Only the existing separately authenticated control boundary may submit a proposal.
Trust Canal admission produces a durable receipt before any future execution stage.
Proposal admission never starts Talos, Hephaestus, Factory, Worker, shell or model execution.
Replay is idempotent and malformed proposals fail closed.
